response_text:
Here are several donor stewardship workflow templates and tools you can use or adapt, based on your search results. I’ll summarize each, then give you a ready-to-use sample matrix you can copy into Excel/Sheets or your CRM.

---

## 1. Visual workflow: Mind map template (AmyMind – Result [1])

**Best for:** Teams that want to *visualize* the whole donor journey.

**Structure:**
- Central node: “Donor Stewardship Plan”
- Branches:
  - Donor segments (e.g., new, recurring, major, lapsed)
  - Touchpoints (welcome emails, calls, events, handwritten notes, etc.)
  - Recognition (thank-you letters, public recognition, exclusive updates)
  - Retention tactics (impact reports, anniversary reminders, renewal nudges)
  - Roles & timelines

**How to use as a workflow:**
1. Create nodes for each segment (New, Monthly, Major, Lapsed).
2. Under each, add:
   - Immediate post-gift steps (within 24–48 hours).
   - Short-term follow-up (within 30–90 days).
   - Ongoing cadence (quarterly/annual).
3. Add sub-nodes for who is responsible and what system you’ll track it in (CRM, email tool, calendar).

---

## 2. Stewardship matrix workflow (A Direct Solution / Double the Donation / Bonterra – Results [2], [4], [5])

**Best for:** A practical, table-based workflow.

Common elements:
- Outreach purpose (acknowledgment, recognition, reporting, engagement)
- Outreach type (email, letter, call, visit, event invite)
- Timeline (e.g., 24 hours after gift, 1 month after, quarterly, annually)
- One-time vs recurring
- Donor segments columns (new, loyal, monthly, major, planned)

### Sample Stewardship Matrix (copy/paste template)

Use columns like this:

| Outreach Purpose | Communication Type | Trigger / Timing               | One-time or Recurring | New Donors | Recurring Donors | Major Donors | Lapsed Donors | Owner     | Notes/Channel             |
|------------------|--------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------|-----------|------------------|--------------|--------------|-----------|---------------------------|
| Acknowledgment   | Automated email receipt | Immediately (within 1 hour of gift) | Recurring              | ✔         | ✔                | ✔            |              | CRM/email | Tax receipt, confirmation |
| Acknowledgment   | Personalized thank-you email | Within 24–48 hours of gift       | Each gift / threshold  | ✔         | ✔ (for upgrades) | ✔            |              | Dev Coord | Include impact-focused language |
| Acknowledgment   | Handwritten note   | Within 5 business days         | Gift over $X           |           |                  | ✔            |              | ED/Board  | Personalized message      |
| Recognition      | New donor welcome series (2–3 emails) | Starts within 3 days of first gift | One-time per donor     | ✔         |                  |              |              | Comms     | Story, mission, how to get involved |
| Reporting        | Quarterly impact email | Quarterly (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec)    | Recurring              | ✔         | ✔                | ✔            |              | Comms     | Segmented highlights      |
| Reporting        | Annual impact/thank-you letter | Every January                  | Recurring              | ✔         | ✔                | ✔            | ✔            | Dev      | Include giving summary if appropriate |
| Engagement       | Event invite (general) | For each major event            | Recurring              | ✔         | ✔                | ✔            | ✔            | Dev/Comms | Fundraising & stewardship events |
| Engagement       | 1:1 phone call check-in | 1–2x per year                   | Recurring              |           |                  | ✔            |              | Major Gifts | Ask for feedback, share updates |
| Re-engagement    | “We miss you” email series | 12+ months since last gift      | One-time per lapsed donor |           |                  |              | ✔            | Dev/Comms | Warm tone, impact stories, low-bar asks |

You can adapt:
- Rows: Add/remove communication types.
- Columns: Add more segments (e.g., mid-level, corporate, foundations).

---

## 3. Board-level plan & template (BoardEffect – Result [3])

**Best for:** Governance view and clarity on responsibilities.

**Workflow template headings:**
- Interactions (specific actions: welcome call, event invite, report)
- Communication Type (email, mail, phone, in-person)
- Timeline (e.g., 0–2 days, 2 weeks, quarterly)
- Columns for each segment (New, Loyal, Major, etc.)

You can model a simple sheet with:

| Interaction              | Type     | Timing   | New | Loyal | Major | Owner        |
|--------------------------|----------|----------|-----|-------|-------|--------------|
| Gift acknowledgment      | Email    | 0–1 day  | ✔   | ✔     | ✔     | Dev Coord    |
| Donor welcome packet     | Mail     | 7 days   | ✔   |       |       | Admin        |
| Personal call after gift | Phone    | 7–10 days|     |       | ✔     | Board/ED     |

---

## 4. Month-by-month workflow templates (Candid, Kindsight, DRG – Results [6], [7], [8])

**Best for:** Annual stewardship calendar.

### Simple Yearly Stewardship Calendar Template

| Month    | Activity                            | Segment(s)                  | Owner            |
|----------|-------------------------------------|-----------------------------|------------------|
| January  | Annual impact report + thank-you    | All active donors           | Dev + Comms      |
| February | “Why I Give” donor story email      | All email subscribers       | Comms            |
| March    | Volunteer invitation                | Mid-level + new donors      | Volunteer Coord  |
| April    | Spring appreciation event           | Major + mid-level donors    | Dev + Events     |
| May      | Handwritten notes to top 50 donors  | Major + top mid-level       | Board/ED         |
| June     | Mid-year impact update email        | All donors                  | Comms            |
| July     | Stewardship calls (no ask)          | Monthly + major donors      | Dev team         |
| August   | Behind-the-scenes update/video      | All donors                  | Comms            |
| September| Lapsed donor re-engagement series   | Lapsed 12–36 months         | Dev/Comms        |
| October  | Donor survey                        | All active donors           | Dev/Comms        |
| November | Gratitude campaign (no ask week)    | All donors                  | Entire org       |
| December | Personalized year-end thank-yous    | Major + monthly donors      | Dev team         |

Use Kindsight’s “Month / Activity / Audience / Responsible” structure as your base.

---

## 5. Quick-start: Minimal “new donor” workflow template

If you just need a simple, concrete workflow you can implement immediately:

**Trigger:** New online gift

1. **0–1 hour** – Automated receipt email (tax info + brief thank you).
2. **24–48 hours** – Branded thank-you email with impact story and short welcome.
3. **Within 7 days** – Add to welcome series (2–3 emails over 3 weeks: mission, story, engagement options).
4. **Within 30 days** – Impact-focused update or story (no ask).
5. **Within 60–90 days** – Light engagement ask (volunteer, follow on social, attend event).
6. **Quarterly** – Impact updates.
7. **Annually** – Personal thank-you with a summary of their impact, before any renewal ask.

Track each of these as steps/tasks in your CRM or project tool.

---

If you tell me:
- Your main donor segments (e.g., “small online donors under $100, mid-level $100–$999, major $1,000+”) and  
- What tools you use (e.g., Salesforce, Bloomerang, Excel),

I can turn this into a tailored, ready-to-import workflow or matrix for you.
